voiceover: My dad has a barbershop here in America. After school, I come right here.
Dad has a big barber chair. And I have a little toy corner.
Emma is always in a hurry. Mr. Miller loves talking about his dog, Milo.
Our neighbor runs the coffee shop. Sometimes she brings us coffee.
When someone opens the door, Dad smiles and says:
I learn a new English phrase here every day. Come back tomorrow for another little story from our shop.
voiceover_zh: 我爸爸在美国开了一家理发店。放学后，我就来这里。

我每天都在这里学一句新英语。明天再来听理发店里的小故事吧。
